An interview that asks three to four labeled questions before any generation. beats.narration_text: Law two: mode by intent. As the SKILL says: pick by intent, not surface keyword. 'Pinterest pin of my product on a kitchen counter' is moodboard-pin — Pinterest is the platform, not lifestyle-scene. 'Hero banner showing my product in use' is hero-banner — banner format wins over the in-use detail. Ten modes, each with a specific intent. The tie-breakers are in the SKILL.

beats.narration_text: Law three: interview short. Three to four questions before generating, labeled options, never open-ended. As the SKILL says: skip questions whose answer is obvious from context — uploaded image, prior turn, brand memory. If the user uploads a product photo and says 'make me a hero banner,' the mode is obvious; ask only what's missing.
